description: ИПЦ: платные услуги, к предыдущему месяцу
methodology: Index, previous month = 100: CPI for paid services (Taldau index 703076, term 4772555), monthly from 2011-01, national. Same index and dictionaries as the headline CPI; December year-on-year values equal BNS element 1548 for 2011-2025.
